Maria R.: Heads up — new DPA intake from HelixCare. They want a SOC2 excerpt (controls list + cert), dataflow diagram, BYOK/KMS provenance, and embeddings retention policy. Renewal window = 45 days. Can someone own evidence gathering?
Sam T.: I can help list exact artifacts we should hand over. quick Q: do they need full SOC2 report or just the cert + mapping?
Maria R.: They asked for the cert and mappings (CC2-CC7 mapping to where we store/process PHI). also access logs for the past 3 months. redaction ok.
Amelia (CS): I can own the triage and bundle. I'll kick off a ticket and collect owners. Sam, can you compile the evidence checklist?
Sam T.: Yup. Preliminary checklist: 1) SOC2 cert PDF, 2) control mapping spreadsheet, 3) data flow diagram (draw.io/PNG), 4) KMS attestation (BYOK statement if relevant), 5) embeddings retention policy + pseudonymization note, 6) access/egress logs (redacted), 7) contact info + point-of-contact.
Julian K.: FYI: We do not offer customer-managed KMS for hosted accounts. If they ask for BYOK proof, provide an attestation template and a note about Dedicated/private options. Suggested wording: "We do not support BYOK on Hosted; we provide encryption at rest with CMK managed by our cloud provider. For Dedicated/Private deployments, BYOK/HSM can be supported — reach out to sales."
Maria R.: Good call. Amelia — include Julian's wording as an appendix. Also we should flag renewal risk if they insist on strict BYOK.
cs-bot: New ticket created: CS-4871 — "HelixCare DPA intake" assigned to Amelia (CS) — due in 3 business days.
Amelia (CS): Plan: 1) create folder in Drive + upload baseline artifacts (SOC2 cert, control mapping); 2) request redacted logs from infra; 3) get KMS attestation draft from Julian; 4) draft customer-facing note on retention/embeddings. I'll post progress here.
sec-bot: Note: For access logs request, follow PII redaction guide: https://confluence.redwood/security/redaction (attach proof of redaction).
Sam T.: Quick template for control mapping attached (I pasted below).
Sam T.: ```
Control ID, Control description, Where implemented (service/component), Evidence file
CC2, Access controls, Redwood AuthN service, access-controls.pdf
CC5, Backup and retention, S3 lifecycle + embeddings-retention.md, backup-report.pdf
```
Maria R.: Deadline: bundle to customer by EOD in 3 business days, unless legal asks to delay. Amelia, escalate to legal if they request full SOC2 report.
Amelia (CS): Acknowledged. Will ping Legal@ and tag here. Also scheduling a 30-min handoff with HelixCare for Monday.
Julian K.: I'll draft KMS attestation + note on Dedicated options by EOD tomorrow and add to the Drive folder.
Maria R.: Thanks all — marking risk level = medium (possible renewal friction if BYOK required). We'll reconvene after initial bundle is ready. :thumbsup:
